meaning: Retrospective membership in the verified CC01 VulnCheck snapshot; NOT_LISTED is not proof of no exploitation.

settings.selection: strict maximum selection AP; earliest epoch wins ties

threshold: Maximize selection F1 over unique probabilities plus 0 and 1; largest threshold wins exact ties; predict p >= cutoff.
source_policy: Use only frozen CC02 screened D and prose M; no G/N or catalogue answer fields. Reuse only byte-identical text/spans with identical processing and encoder identities.
epss_policy: Use only CC02 verified prepared date-aligned EPSS plus its observation mask. Never substitute an older archive or Day-60 target.
assessment_policy: All selected checkpoints and selection-fitted cutoffs locked before inner assessment joins. Existing official validation/test roles are never adapted.
calibration: No post-hoc calibrator; report uncalibrated probabilities, Brier, log loss and ten fixed equal-width bins.
